newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Holderbank buys 51 pct of Romanian Cimentul.
newsitem.headline: Holderbank buys 51 pct of Romanian Cimentul.

text.p: Holderbank Financiere Glarus AG, the world's leading supplier of building materials, said it had signed a contract with the Romanian state to acquire 51 percent of the share capital of Cimentul SA Turda.
Holderbank said it was paying $11.75 million for the stake in Cimentul, which is practically free of debt.

For the time being, 19 percent of the remaining 49 percent of the share capital will remain in the hands of the state, while 30 percent have already been ceeded by coupons during the privatisation process.

Cimentul operates a cement, gypsum and lime plant 30 kms south-east of the city of Cluj-Napuca. The cement kilns have an annual capacity of 0.8 million tonnes of grey cement and 0.1 million tonnes of white cement.

Holderbank said the entry into Romania not only opened new markets in Eastern Europe, but also creates interesting possibilities for networking with other Holderbank group companies in Central and Eastern Europe.
Holderbank is present in the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary and Croatia. A few weeks ago it also signed a preliminary agreement to buy a Bulgarian cement company.
